+def _edge(source: str, edge_type: str, target: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

+        if edge.get("edge_type") == "SUPPORTED_BY":

+        if (

+            or node_index.get(target, {}).get("status") == "candidate"
+        ):
+            candidate_exposed += 1
+
+    structural_orphans = 0
+    question_ids = {
+        node_id
+        for node_id, node in node_index.items()
+        if node.get("node_type") == "Question"
+    }
+    for node_id, node in node_index.items():
+        require(node.get("node_type") in NODE_TYPES, f"unsupported node type: {node_id}")
+        require(node.get("status") in STATUS_LANES, f"unsupported node status: {node_id}")
+        node_type = node["node_type"]
+        if node_type == "QuestionPart":
+            question_id = node.get("question_id")
+            parent_id = node.get("parent_question_part_id")

+                question_id not in question_ids

+            ):

+        elif node_type == "EvidenceAnchor" and incoming_support[node_id] == 0:

+    gates: dict[str, int | str] = {
+        "candidate_exposed_as_approved_count": candidate_exposed,
+        "dangling_edge_count": dangling,
+        "duplicate_active_identity_count": duplicate_count,
+        "provider_call_count": 0,
+        "remote_write_count": 0,
+        "safe_rejection_input_count": 0,
+        "stale_authority_reference_count": stale_authority,
+        "structural_authority_write_count": 0,
+        "structural_orphan_count": structural_orphans,
+        "unsupported_inferred_edge_count": unsupported_inferred,
+        "verified_input_question_count": len(question_ids),
+    }
+    require(dangling == 0, "dangling edge")
+    require(structural_orphans == 0, "structural orphan")
+    require(candidate_exposed == 0, "candidate exposed as approved")
+    require(unsupported_inferred == 0, "unsupported inferred edge")
+    require(stale_authority == 0, "stale authority reference")
+    require(
+        len(question_ids) == EXPECTED_VERIFIED_QUESTIONS,
+        "verified input question count drift",

+    )
+    require(
+        staging.get("verified_count") == EXPECTED_VERIFIED_QUESTIONS,
+        "verified staging count declaration mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        set(staging.get("allowed_states", [])) == VERIFIED_STATES,
+        "verified staging allowed-state boundary mismatch",
+    )
+
+    question_rows = question_ledger.get("rows")
+    require(isinstance(question_rows, list), "question ledger has no rows")
+    question_index = {row.get("question_id"): row for row in question_rows}
+    require(
+        len(question_index) == len(question_rows),
+        "question ledger has duplicate identities",
+    )
+    safe_ids = {
+        row["question_id"]
+        for row in question_rows
+        if row.get("state") == "safe_rejection"
+    }
+    require(
+        len(safe_ids) == EXPECTED_SAFE_REJECTIONS,
+        "question ledger must contain exactly 36 safe rejections",
+    )
+
+    paper_index, source_index = _paper_source_index(paper_ledger)
+    node_rows = node_ledger.get("rows")
+    require(isinstance(node_rows, list), "node ledger has no rows")
+    node_index = {row.get("node_id"): row for row in node_rows}
+    require(len(node_index) == len(node_rows), "node ledger has duplicate identities")
+
+    staging_ids: set[str] = set()
+    projected_node_ids: set[str] = set()
+    for row in rows:
+        question_id = row.get("question_id")
+        question = row.get("question")
+        require(
+            isinstance(question_id, str)
+            and question_id not in staging_ids
+            and isinstance(question, dict),
+            f"duplicate or invalid staging question: {question_id!r}",
+        )
+        staging_ids.add(question_id)
+        require(question.get("question_id") == question_id, f"question id drift: {question_id}")
+        require(
+            question.get("verification_state") in VERIFIED_STATES,
+            f"non-verified staging question: {question_id}",
+        )
+        ledger_row = question_index.get(question_id)
+        require(
+            ledger_row is not None
+            and ledger_row.get("state") == question["verification_state"]
+            and ledger_row.get("paper_id") == question.get("paper_id"),
+            f"question ledger mismatch: {question_id}",
+        )
+        paper_id = question.get("paper_id")
+        paper = paper_index.get(paper_id)
+        require(paper is not None, f"question paper is absent from ledger: {question_id}")
+        expected_membership = {
+            paper["qp"]["source_object_id"],
+            paper["ms"]["source_object_id"],
+        }
+        require(
+            set(question.get("source_membership", [])) == expected_membership,
+            f"question source membership mismatch: {question_id}",
+        )
+        for evidence in question.get("authoritative_regions", []):
+            require(
+                _validate_evidence(evidence, source_index, question_id) == "qp",
+                f"question authority is not QP evidence: {question_id}",
+            )
+
+        nodes = row.get("structural_nodes")
+        require(isinstance(nodes, list) and nodes, f"question has no parts: {question_id}")
+        owners = {node.get("owner_path") for node in nodes}
+        require(
+            len(owners) == len(nodes) and None not in owners,
+            f"duplicate or invalid owner path: {question_id}",
+        )
+        for node in nodes:
+            owner = node["owner_path"]
+            parent = node.get("parent_owner_path")
+            require(
+                parent is None or parent in owners,
+                f"QuestionPart has no parent authority: {question_id}:{owner}",
+            )
+            require(
+                node.get("role") in {"instruction_only", "score_owning"},
+                f"invalid structural role: {question_id}:{owner}",
+            )
+            for evidence in node.get("page_region_evidence", []):
+                require(
+                    _validate_evidence(
+                        evidence, source_index, f"{question_id}:{owner}:qp"
+                    )
+                    == "qp",
+                    f"QuestionPart QP evidence has wrong source role: {question_id}:{owner}",
+                )
+            for evidence in node.get("ms_evidence", []):
+                require(
+                    _validate_evidence(
+                        evidence, source_index, f"{question_id}:{owner}:ms"
+                    )
+                    == "ms",
+                    f"QuestionPart MS evidence has wrong source role: {question_id}:{owner}",
+                )
+            expected = _expected_node_ledger_row(question_id, paper_id, node)
+            ledger_node = node_index.get(expected["node_id"])
+            require(ledger_node == expected, f"node ledger mismatch: {expected['node_id']}")
+            projected_node_ids.add(expected["node_id"])
+
+    verified_ledger_ids = {
+        question_id
+        for question_id, row in question_index.items()
+        if row.get("state") in VERIFIED_STATES
+    }
+    require(
+        staging_ids == verified_ledger_ids,
+        "verified staging does not exactly conserve question ledger identities",
+    )
+    require(not staging_ids.intersection(safe_ids), "safe rejection entered verified staging")
+    require(
+        projected_node_ids == set(node_index),
+        "verified staging does not exactly conserve node ledger identities",
+    )
+    return {
+        "rows": rows,
+        "input_artifacts": [
+            *[inputs[name] for name in REQUIRED_INPUTS],
+            source_manifest_record,
+        ],
+        "source_index": source_index,
+        "safe_rejection_ids": safe_ids,
+    }
+
+
+def _anchor_projection(
+    evidence: dict[str, Any], source_role: str
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    core = {
+        "crop_sha256": evidence["crop_sha256"],
+        "evidence_manifest_sha256": evidence["evidence_manifest_sha256"],
+        "page_image_sha256": evidence["page_image_sha256"],
+        "page_number": evidence["page_number"],
+        "region_id": evidence["region_id"],
+        "source_object_id": evidence["source_object_id"],
+        "source_role": source_role,
+        "source_sha256": evidence["source_sha256"],
+    }
+    anchor_id = f"eanchor::{sha256_bytes(compact_bytes(core))}"
+    return {
+        "node_id": anchor_id,
+        "node_type": "EvidenceAnchor",
+        "status": "structural",
+        **core,
+        "logical_evidence_reference": (
+            f"{core['source_object_id']}#page={core['page_number']}"
+            f"&region={core['region_id']}&crop_sha256={core['crop_sha256']}"
+        ),
+    }
+
+
+def _edge(source: str, edge_type: str, target: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    identity = [source, edge_type, target]
+    return {
+        "edge_id": f"edge::{sha256_bytes(compact_bytes(identity))}",
+        "edge_type": edge_type,
+        "from_node_id": source,
+        "inferred": False,
+        "status": "structural",
+        "to_node_id": target,
+    }
+
+
+def build_graph(authority: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    nodes: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    edges: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    source_index = authority["source_index"]
+
+    def add_node(node: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        node_id = node["node_id"]
+        require(node_id not in nodes or nodes[node_id] == node, f"duplicate active identity: {node_id}")
+        nodes[node_id] = node
+
+    def add_edge(edge: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        edge_id = edge["edge_id"]
+        require(edge_id not in edges or edges[edge_id] == edge, f"duplicate active edge: {edge_id}")
+        edges[edge_id] = edge
+
+    def add_anchor(evidence: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+        role = source_index[evidence["source_object_id"]]["source_role"]
+        anchor = _anchor_projection(evidence, role)
+        add_node(anchor)
+        return anchor["node_id"]
+
+    for row in sorted(authority["rows"], key=lambda item: item["question_id"]):
+        question = row["question"]
+        question_id = row["question_id"]
+        add_node(
+            {
+                "complete_page_chain": question["complete_page_chain"],
+                "node_id": question_id,
+                "node_type": "Question",
+                "paper_id": question["paper_id"],
+                "printed_question_number": question["printed_question_number"],
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "source_membership": question["source_membership"],
+                "status": "structural",
+                "verification_state": question["verification_state"],
+            }
+        )
+        for evidence in question.get("authoritative_regions", []):
+            add_edge(_edge(question_id, "SUPPORTED_BY", add_anchor(evidence)))
+
+        for source_node in sorted(
+            row["structural_nodes"], key=lambda item: item["owner_path"]
+        ):
+            part_id = f"{question_id}::{source_node['owner_path']}"
+            parent = source_node.get("parent_owner_path")
+            add_node(
+                {
+                    "continuation": source_node.get("continuation"),
+                    "inheritance": source_node.get("inheritance"),
+                    "node_id": part_id,
+                    "node_type": "QuestionPart",
+                    "owner_path": source_node["owner_path"],
+                    "parent_question_part_id": (
+                        None if parent is None else f"{question_id}::{parent}"
+                    ),
+                    "printed_label": source_node.get("printed_label"),
+                    "printed_marks": source_node.get("printed_marks"),
+                    "question_id": question_id,
+                    "reset_behavior": source_node.get("reset_behavior"),
+                    "role": source_node["role"],
+                    "status": "structural",
+                    "whole_question_alias": source_node.get(
+                        "whole_question_alias", False
+                    ),
+                }
+            )
+            add_edge(_edge(question_id, "HAS_PART", part_id))
+            for evidence in (
+                source_node.get("page_region_evidence", [])
+                + source_node.get("ms_evidence", [])
+            ):
+                add_edge(_edge(part_id, "SUPPORTED_BY", add_anchor(evidence)))
+
+    type_order = {
+        "Question": 0,
+        "QuestionPart": 1,
+        "EvidenceAnchor": 2,
+    }
+    nodes_document = {
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "nodes": sorted(
+            nodes.values(),
+            key=lambda node: (type_order.get(node["node_type"], 99), node["node_id"]),
+        ),
+        "schema_version": "9709_kg_v0_nodes_v1",
+        "status_lanes": list(STATUS_LANES),
+    }
+    edges_document = {
+        "edges": sorted(edges.values(), key=lambda edge: edge["edge_id"]),
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "schema_version": "9709_kg_v0_edges_v1",
+        "status_lanes": list(STATUS_LANES),
+    }
+    return nodes_document, edges_document
+
+
+def validate_graph(
+    nodes_document: dict[str, Any],
+    edges_document: dict[str, Any],
+    input_artifacts: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    expected_input_artifacts: list[dict[str, Any]],
+) -> dict[str, int | str]:
+    nodes = nodes_document.get("nodes")
+    edges = edges_document.get("edges")
+    require(isinstance(nodes, list), "nodes artifact has no nodes")
+    require(isinstance(edges, list), "edges artifact has no edges")
+    require(
+        nodes_document.get("status_lanes") == list(STATUS_LANES)
+        and edges_document.get("status_lanes") == list(STATUS_LANES),
+        "status-lane contract drift",
+    )
+
+    node_ids = [node.get("node_id") for node in nodes]
+    edge_ids = [edge.get("edge_id") for edge in edges]
+    duplicate_count = (len(node_ids) - len(set(node_ids))) + (
+        len(edge_ids) - len(set(edge_ids))
+    )
+    require(duplicate_count == 0, "duplicate active identity")
+    node_index = {
+        node["node_id"]: node
+        for node in nodes
+        if isinstance(node, dict) and isinstance(node.get("node_id"), str)
+    }
+    require(len(node_index) == len(nodes), "invalid node identity")
+
+    dangling = 0
+    unsupported_inferred = 0
+    candidate_exposed = 0
+    incoming_support: Counter[str] = Counter()
+    has_part: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
+    procedure_parent: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
+    for edge in edges:
+        source = edge.get("from_node_id")
+        target = edge.get("to_node_id")
+        if source not in node_index or target not in node_index:
+            dangling += 1
+        if edge.get("edge_type") not in EDGE_TYPES or edge.get("inferred") is not False:
+            unsupported_inferred += 1
+        require(
+            edge.get("status") in STATUS_LANES,
+            f"unsupported edge status: {edge.get('edge_id')}",
+        )
+        if edge.get("edge_type") == "SUPPORTED_BY":
+            incoming_support[target] += 1
+        if edge.get("edge_type") == "HAS_PART":
+            has_part.add((source, target))
+        if (
+            edge.get("edge_type") == "HAS_STEP"
+            and node_index.get(source, {}).get("node_type") == "ProcedureModel"
+            and node_index.get(target, {}).get("node_type") == "ProcedureStep"
+        ):
+            procedure_parent.add((source, target))
+        if edge.get("status") == "approved" and (
+            node_index.get(source, {}).get("status") == "candidate"
+            or node_index.get(target, {}).get("status") == "candidate"
+        ):
+            candidate_exposed += 1
+
+    structural_orphans = 0
+    question_ids = {
+        node_id
+        for node_id, node in node_index.items()
+        if node.get("node_type") == "Question"
+    }
+    for node_id, node in node_index.items():
+        require(node.get("node_type") in NODE_TYPES, f"unsupported node type: {node_id}")
+        require(node.get("status") in STATUS_LANES, f"unsupported node status: {node_id}")
+        node_type = node["node_type"]
+        if node_type == "QuestionPart":
+            question_id = node.get("question_id")
+            parent_id = node.get("parent_question_part_id")
+            if (
+                question_id not in question_ids
+                or (question_id, node_id) not in has_part
+                or (parent_id is not None and parent_id not in node_index)
+            ):
+                structural_orphans += 1
+        elif node_type == "EvidenceAnchor" and incoming_support[node_id] == 0:
+            structural_orphans += 1
+        elif node_type == "ProcedureStep":
+            parent = node.get("procedure_model_id")
+            if parent not in node_index or (parent, node_id) not in procedure_parent:
+                structural_orphans += 1
+
+    stale_authority = 0 if input_artifacts == expected_input_artifacts else 1
+    gates: dict[str, int | str] = {
+        "candidate_exposed_as_approved_count": candidate_exposed,
+        "dangling_edge_count": dangling,
+        "duplicate_active_identity_count": duplicate_count,
+        "provider_call_count": 0,
+        "remote_write_count": 0,
+        "safe_rejection_input_count": 0,
+        "stale_authority_reference_count": stale_authority,
+        "structural_authority_write_count": 0,
+        "structural_orphan_count": structural_orphans,
+        "unsupported_inferred_edge_count": unsupported_inferred,
+        "verified_input_question_count": len(question_ids),
+    }
+    require(dangling == 0, "dangling edge")
+    require(structural_orphans == 0, "structural orphan")
+    require(candidate_exposed == 0, "candidate exposed as approved")
+    require(unsupported_inferred == 0, "unsupported inferred edge")
+    require(stale_authority == 0, "stale authority reference")
+    require(
+        len(question_ids) == EXPECTED_VERIFIED_QUESTIONS,
+        "verified input question count drift",
+    )
+    return gates
+
+
+def projection_counts(
+    nodes_document: dict[str, Any], edges_document: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    nodes = nodes_document.get("nodes", [])
+    edges = edges_document.get("edges", [])
+    node_counts = Counter(node["node_type"] for node in nodes)
+    edge_counts = Counter(edge["edge_type"] for edge in edges)
+    return {
+        "edges_by_type": dict(sorted(edge_counts.items())),
+        "nodes_by_type": dict(sorted(node_counts.items())),
+        "total_edges": len(edges),
+        "total_nodes": len(nodes),
+    }
+
+
+def build_release(
+    repo: Path,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    authority = load_authority(repo)
+    nodes_document, edges_document = build_graph(authority)
+    output_records = []
+    for name, document in (
+        ("kg-v0-nodes.json", nodes_document),
+        ("kg-v0-edges.json", edges_document),
+    ):
+        value = canonical_bytes(document)
+        output_records.append(
+            {
+                "byte_length": len(value),
+                "path": (OUTPUT_RELATIVE / name).as_posix(),
+                "sha256": sha256_bytes(value),
+            }
+        )
+    gates = validate_graph(
+        nodes_document,
+        edges_document,
+        authority["input_artifacts"],
+        authority["input_artifacts"],
+    )
+    gates["deterministic_rebuild"] = "PASS"
+    manifest = {
+        "hard_completion_gates": gates,
+        "input_artifacts": authority["input_artifacts"],
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "non_blocking_coverage_metrics": {
+            "approved_semantic_node_count": 0,
+            "candidate_semantic_node_count": 0,
+            "procedure_coverage": 0,
+            "question_type_coverage": 0,
+            "representative_question_coverage": 0,
+            "semantic_orphan_count": 0,
+            "unclassified_question_count": EXPECTED_VERIFIED_QUESTIONS,
+        },
+        "output_artifacts": output_records,
+        "projection_counts": projection_counts(nodes_document, edges_document),
+        "schema_version": "9709_kg_v0_release_manifest_v1",
+        "source_issue": SOURCE_ISSUE,
+        "starting_authority_git_commit": STARTING_AUTHORITY,
+        "write_posture": "local_artifact_only",
+    }
+    return nodes_document, edges_document, manifest
+
+
+def validate_release(
+    repo: Path, output_dir: Path
+) -> dict[str, int | str]:
+    authority = load_authority(repo)
+    nodes_document = read_json(output_dir / "kg-v0-nodes.json")
+    edges_document = read_json(output_dir / "kg-v0-edges.json")
+    manifest = read_json(output_dir / "kg-v0-release-manifest.json")
+    expected_nodes, expected_edges = build_graph(authority)
